sources.title: GitHub - CompImg/LST-AI: LST-AI - Deep Learning Ensemble for Accurate ...
sources.snippet: LST-AI is an advanced deep learning-based extension of the original LST with improved performance and additional features. LST-AI constitutes a completely new framework and has been developed from scratch. While LST depends on MATLAB, we offer LST-AI as a python-based tool which makes it available to the whole community.

sources.snippet: In particular, new climate impacts have exacerbated the complexity of ENSO changes. In this study, we proposed a novel spatio-temporal neural network model, LSTA-Swin, that aggregates long- and short-term information, to improve the accuracy of ENSO prediction.
